result:
I’ll inspect span serialization and the existing tests, then add copy and pickle support. I’ll follow the repository’s Python style skill and run focused tests without installing dependencies.
The immutable span wraps OpenTelemetry objects that contain locks. The lazy span also materializes during copy-protocol lookups. I’ll serialize their span data and attachments, restore lazy spans without loading them, and add a clear error for copying or pickling live spans.
The first test run produced no-op spans in both new and existing tests. The environment has an inherited OTLP exporter configuration that appears to be interfering with tracing. I’ll rerun with those variables unset for the test process.
Implemented copy and pickle support for immutable, lazy, and no-op spans, including whole traces and attachments. Lazy spans restore unloaded without duplicate raw JSON. Shallow copies retain shared underlying spans; live spans reject deep copy and pickle with guidance to call `to_immutable_span()`.

Added regression coverage. All 102 span tests passed with inherited OTLP settings unset and pytest’s sandbox-incompatible summary hook disabled. No dependencies installed.

 )
 
+from tests.tracing.helper import create_test_trace_info
+
+
+def pickle_roundtrip(value):
+    return pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(value))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, pickle_roundtrip])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("span_kind", ["immutable", "lazy", "materialized"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("whole_trace", [False, True])
+def test_span_copy_and_pickle(restore, span_kind, whole_trace):
+    with mlflow.start_span("parent"):
+        with mlflow.start_span("child", span_type=SpanType.LLM) as live:
+            live.set_inputs({"items": [1, 2]})
+            live.set_outputs({"result": 3})
+            live.add_event(SpanEvent("event", timestamp=123, attributes={"key": "value"}))
+            live.add_link(Link(trace_id=live.trace_id, span_id=live.parent_id))
+            live.set_status(SpanStatus(SpanStatusCode.ERROR, "error"))
+
+    span = live.to_immutable_span()
+    expected = span.to_dict()
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        span = LazySpan(expected, raw_json=json.dumps(expected))
+        if span_kind == "materialized":
+            assert span.name == "child"
+    attachment = Attachment(content_type="text/plain", content_bytes=b"attachment")
+    span._attachments = {attachment.id: attachment}
+    original = (
+        Trace(info=create_test_trace_info(live.trace_id), data=TraceData(spans=[span]))
+        if whole_trace
+        else span
+    )
+
+    restored = restore(original)
+    if whole_trace:
+        assert restored.info == original.info
+        restored = restored.data.spans[0]
+    assert restored is not span
+    assert type(restored) is type(span)
+    if span_kind != "immutable":
+        assert restored.__dict__["_materialized"] is False
+        assert restored.__dict__["_raw_json"] is None
+        assert span.__dict__["_materialized"] is (span_kind == "materialized")
+        assert set(span.__getstate__()) == {"span_data", "attachments"}
+    assert restored.to_dict() == expected
+    assert restored.name == "child"
+    assert restored.inputs == {"items": [1, 2]}
+    assert restored.outputs == {"result": 3}
+    assert restored.links == span.links
+    assert restored._attachments[attachment.id].__dict__ == attachment.__dict__
+    assert restored._attachments[attachment.id] is not attachment
+    restored.inputs["items"].append(4)
+    assert span.inputs == {"items": [1, 2]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.deepcopy, pickle_roundtrip])
+def test_live_span_copy_and_pickle_rejected(restore):
+    with mlflow.start_span("live") as span:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match=r"to_immutable_span\(\)"):
+            restore(span)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("immutable", [False, True])
+def test_span_shallow_copy(immutable):
+    with mlflow.start_span("span") as live:
+        span = live.to_immutable_span() if immutable else live
+        copied = copy.copy(span)
+        assert copied is not span
+        assert type(copied) is type(span)
+        assert copied._span is span._span
+        assert copied.inputs == span.inputs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, pickle_roundtrip])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_context", [False, True])
+def test_no_op_span_copy_and_pickle(restore, with_context):
+    context = build_otel_context(123, 456) if with_context else None
+    span = NoOpSpan(trace_api.NonRecordingSpan(context))
+    restored = restore(span)
+    assert isinstance(restored, NoOpSpan)
+    assert restored is not span
+    assert restored.trace_id == span.trace_id
+    assert restored.name is None
+    assert restored._span.get_span_context() == context
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("restore", [copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, pickle_roundtrip])
+def test_unloaded_lazy_span_copy_and_pickle(restore):
+    span = LazySpan({"name": "unloaded"}, raw_json='{"name": "unloaded"}')
+    restored = restore(span)
+    assert span.__dict__["_materialized"] is False
+    assert restored.__dict__["_materialized"] is False
+    assert restored.to_dict() == {"name": "unloaded"}
+
